entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that may support multi-homed IPv6 PDU sessions.

entities.name: Multi-homed IPv6 PDU session
entities.description: A PDU session type that allows multiple IPv6 prefixes for the same session.

entities.name: Type C host
entities.description: UE acting as a type C host as specified in IETF RFC 4191.

entities.name: UE-requested PDU session establishment
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to establish a PDU session.

entities.name: UE-requested PDU session modification
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to modify an existing PDU session.

entities.name: IPv4v6 PDU session type
entities.description: PDU session type supporting both IPv4 and IPv6.

entities.name: Inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode
entities.description: Condition where UE moves from S1 mode to N1 mode.

entities.name: Single-registration mode with N26 interface
entities.description: Condition where UE operates in single-registration mode in a network supporting N26 interface.

relations.description: UE may support multi-homed IPv6 PDU session.
If UE supports multi-homed IPv6 PDU session, it shall support acting as a type C host.
UE indicates support of multi-homed IPv6 PDU session during UE-requested PDU session establishment for IPv6 or IPv4v6 PDU session types.
UE indicates support of multi-homed IPv6 PDU session during UE-requested PDU session modification after inter-system change from S1 to N1 mode, under specific conditions.
UE-requested PDU session establishment requires IPv6 or IPv4v6 PDU session type for multi-homed IPv6 support indication.
UE-requested PDU session establishment requires IPv6 or IPv4v6 PDU session type for multi-homed IPv6 support indication.
UE-requested PDU session modification for multi-homed IPv6 support indication requires inter-system change from S1 to N1 mode.
UE-requested PDU session modification for multi-homed IPv6 support indication requires UE to be in single-registration mode with N26 interface support.
UE-requested PDU session modification for multi-homed IPv6 support indication requires IPv6 or IPv4v6 PDU session type.
UE-requested PDU session modification for multi-homed IPv6 support indication requires IPv6 or IPv4v6 PDU session type.
